title: EE launches its fastest fibre broadband ever - 8GB per second speeds should appeal to home workers, gamers and AI…
excerpt: As long as you're in Surrey
content_html:
• Advanced Full Fibre Broadband from EE offers download speeds of 2.3Gbps and 8Gbps
  • Speeds are potentially 222 times faster than standard superfast fibre
  • Initially available in Guildford and Woking, expanding as Openreach rolls out its XGS-PON glass fibre network

Following a successful trial in early 2026, EE has launched its new Advanced Full Fibre Broadband plans, advertising download speeds of 2.3Gbps and 8Gbps. This makes EE the first provider to sell access to the Openreach XGS-PON glass fibre network.

The plans are initially only available in the Guildford and Woking areas, two Surrey towns in the London commuter belt, where the glass fibre network is installed and active.

EE is targeting users who rely on video conferencing, remote working, and content upload, and with multiple Internet of Things devices, as well as online gamers and streaming consumers. Speeds are up to 222 times faster than the standard superfast fibre broadband plans.

Two plans for EE’s XGS-PON fibre

Customers can access two plans from EE. The 2.3Gbps Advanced Full Fibre Broadband plan starts at £54.99 per month, while the 8Gbps plan is available from £74.99 a month.

No upload speeds have been stated, nor are they listed on the sign-up page, but they can be expected to be similarly fast.

XGS-PON (10-Gigabit-capable Symmetric Passive Optical Network) is a high speed, high-bandwidth data network standard, currently available in various forms across Europe, North America, and other regions. In the UK, it is used in the nexfibre, CityFibre, and Openreach networks, with EE using the latter to provide these plans.

With streaming speeds supporting 4K and 8K video, these plans are likely to be popular where available, and support for up to 190 devices suggests the plans will include routers suited to IoT and smart home applications.

Will faster fibre improve British broadband?

“Today marks a major milestone for EE as we become the first major UK provider to offer broadband speeds of up to 8Gbps on next-generation XGS-PON technology," noted Luciano Oliveira, Director of Product, Home and TV at EE.

"As homes become more connected and customers place greater demands on their broadband, we're investing in the technologies that will power the next generation of digital experiences.”

EE regularly wins recognition as the UK’s most popular network, with its business built on mobile (where its 4G, 5G and 5GSA speeds cover more than 90% of the UK) and an advertising campaign featuring Hollywood actor Kevin Bacon.

Unlike Virgin Media which owns its own fibre network, EE’s domestic and business broadband plans rely on third party infrastructure, mostly provided by Openreach, and due to the differences in connections across the country (and the legacy copper lines that remain in place in some locations), struggles to offer the same speeds for all customers.

This is a problem faced by all providers who sell access to Openreach lines, so EE’s immediate competitors will no doubt be watching with interest.

content_html_zh:
• EE 的高级全光纤宽带提供 2.3Gbps 和 8Gbps 的下载速度
  • 速度可能比标准超快光纤快 222 倍
  • 最初在吉尔福德和沃金提供，随着 Openreach 推出其 XGS-PON 玻璃光纤网络而扩展

继 2026 年初成功试验后，EE 推出了新的高级全光纤宽带计划，宣传下载速度为 2.3Gbps 和 8Gbps。 这使得 EE 成为第一家销售 Openreach XGS-PON 玻璃光纤网络接入的提供商。

该计划最初仅适用于吉尔福德和沃金地区，这两个位于伦敦通勤带的萨里城镇，玻璃纤维网络已安装并处于运行状态。

EE 的目标用户是依赖视频会议、远程工作和内容上传以及使用多个物联网设备的用户，以及在线游戏玩家和流媒体消费者。 速度比标准超高速光纤宽带计划快 222 倍。

EE 的 XGS-PON 光纤的两个计划

客户可以从 EE 访问两个计划。 2.3Gbps 高级全光纤宽带计划起价为每月 54.99 英镑，而 8Gbps 计划起价为每月 74.99 英镑。

没有说明上传速度，也没有在注册页面上列出，但预计它们的速度同样快。

XGS-PON（10G 对称无源光网络）是一种高速、高带宽数据网络标准，目前在欧洲、北美和其他地区以各种形式提供。 在英国，它用于 nexfibre、CityFibre 和 Openreach 网络，EE 使用后者来提供这些计划。

由于流媒体速度支持 4K 和 8K 视频，这些计划可能会很受欢迎，并且支持多达 190 种设备，表明这些计划将包括适合物联网和智能家居应用的路由器。

订阅 TechRadar Pro 时事通讯，获取您的企业成功所需的所有热门新闻、观点、功能和指导！

更快的光纤会改善英国的宽带吗？

EE 产品、家庭和电视总监 Luciano Oliveira 表示：“今天是 EE 的一个重要里程碑，我们成为第一家利用下一代 XGS-PON 技术提供高达 8Gbps 宽带速度的英国主要提供商。”

“随着家庭的互联程度越来越高，客户对宽带的要求越来越高，我们正在投资支持下一代数字体验的技术。”

EE 经常被公认为英国最受欢迎的网络，其业务建立在移动基础上（其 4G、5G 和 5GSA 速度覆盖英国 90% 以上的地区）以及由好莱坞演员凯文·培根 (Kevin Bacon) 主演的广告活动。

与拥有自己的光纤网络的 Virgin Media 不同，EE 的家庭和企业宽带计划依赖于第三方基础设施（主要由 Openreach 提供），并且由于全国各地的连接差异（以及某些地方仍然保留的传统铜线），很难为所有客户提供相同的速度。

这是所有出售 Openreach 线路接入的提供商都面临的问题，因此 EE 的直接竞争对手无疑会饶有兴趣地关注。
